summary_en: 600,000 shares (3.12% of shares outstanding) acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-06-30 at closing price of ¥1,424/share, up to ¥854.4M. All shares to be cancelled by 2026-07-03. Single-tranche block under authorization granted 2026-05-13 for up to 1M shares (5.28% S/O) and ¥1.6B through 2026-12-31.
title_en: Notice of Acquisition and Cancellation of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 29 June 2026, Yamaura Corporation announced a single-tranche buyback block to be executed on 30 June 2026. The company will acquire up to 600,000 shares of its own ordinary stock via ToSTNeT-3 (off-hours block trading on the Tokyo Stock Exchange) at the closing price of ¥1,424 per share, with a total acquisition cap of ¥854.4 million. This block represents 3.12% of shares outstanding (computed as 600,000 ÷ 19,201,600 ex-treasury shares). The acquisition is a single-session order valid only during the designated 08:45 trading window on 30 June 2026; results will be published immediately after the session closes. The entire block of acquired shares will be cancelled by 3 July 2026. This tranche executes part of a ¥1.6 billion, 1-million-share authorization approved by the board on 13 May 2026, which runs through 31 December 2026. As of 29 June 2026, no shares had yet been acquired under the broader authorization.
